verdict.rationale: Formant's operations pages claim configurable alerts, automated incident detection, and alerts for anomalies across the fleet. The docs also describe webhooks and commands triggered by Formant events, so a native alerting and event mechanism exists. However, nothing in the evidence covers alert types for faults, battery levels, or connectivity loss, and most support is marketing copy rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: documented alert conditions for robot faults, battery thresholds and connectivity/offline status; detailed alert configuration and notification-channel docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can get alerts on robot faults, battery, and connectivity so issues are caught before customers notice

citations.quote: Real-time telemetry and status updates across your entire fleet. Configurable alerts and automated incident detection
Set up alerts for anomalies, track mission progress, and respond to issues before they become downtime.
A webhook allows you to make an API call to any endpoint over HTTP based on a trigger from a Formant event.
